title: entitopia index-settings envelope
description: Envelope only, for the same reason as index-mappings: `settings` is Elasticsearch's own DSL, including the analysis chain, and the cluster rejects a bad one outright — index creation fails without the analysis-icu and analysis-phonetic plugins the analyzers require. An analyzer that is well-formed but names a column the data no longer has is the failure worth catching, and no schema can see that; the validate phase's live-cluster tier is where it belongs.

index.description: Must name the same index as this step's index-config.
